english_retrieval.title: Subramanian Swamy - Wikipedia
english_retrieval.snippet: # Subramanian Swamy. In this Indian name, the name *Subramanian* is a patronymic, and the person should be referred to by the given name, *Swamy*. | Union Minister of Commerce and Industry "Ministry of Commerce and Industry (India)") |. Before joining politics, he was a professor of Mathematical Economics at the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi.*[citation needed*] He is known for his Hindu nationalist views. Swamy was a member of the Planning Commission of India "Planning Commission (India)") and was a Cabinet Minister in the Chandra Shekhar government. V. Narasimha Rao. Swamy was a long-time member of the Janata Party, serving as its president until 2013 when he joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Sitaraman Subramanian was an officer in the Indian Statistical Service who served as the director of the Central Statistical Institute in Delhi, and was a statistical adviser to the Government of India.
